config.label: Project root directory for Lex runtime discovery
config.description: Project root directory for Lex runtime discovery. Defaults to current working directory.

config.label: Frame-store backend: sqlite or postgres
config.description: Frame-store backend: sqlite or postgres. Defaults to sqlite unless LEX_DATABASE_URL selects PostgreSQL.

config.label: Path to SQLite database file
config.description: Path to SQLite database file. Defaults to .smartergpt/lex/memory.db under the project root.

config.label: Alias for LEX_DB_PATH (backwards compatibility)
config.description: Alias for LEX_DB_PATH (backwards compatibility). Same behavior.

config.label: PostgreSQL connection URL for the compatibility adapter
config.description: PostgreSQL connection URL for the compatibility adapter. Treat as secret because it may contain credentials.

config.label: PostgreSQL password supplied separately when LEX_DATABASE_URL omits one
config.description: PostgreSQL password supplied separately when LEX_DATABASE_URL omits one.

config.label: Maximum PostgreSQL compatibility-adapter pool size
config.description: Maximum PostgreSQL compatibility-adapter pool size. Defaults to 10.

config.label: Set to any value to enable debug logging to stderr
config.description: Set to any value to enable debug logging to stderr.
